key_insight: A passing automated check validates the checked artefact, not necessarily the original research claim, so human oversight and fidelity audits remain essential.
engineering_relevance: Engineering verification workflows should combine validated tools, checks of claim-to-model fidelity, human decision gates, and explicit attribution of human and AI contributions.
method: Use validated, agent-accessible tools with different grounds of trust.
Audit whether each check addresses the claim as stated, with human decisions at fixed points.
Record human and AI contributions in a dialog report.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes mathematics and statistics tool-layer implementations and a two-claim mathematics demonstration in which an ambiguous claim was split into one refuted reading and one proved reading.
watch_item: The small demonstration does not establish scalability, and faithful translation into a formal statement cannot be decided automatically in general.
paper_title: Trust, but verify, audit and attribute: a human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced research results
